purpose: Gap-narrowing Book enrichment focused on black-speck contamination/degradation diagnosis and hot-runner actual-state control. Sources were screened against the repository before admission; this wave does not claim to close the remaining raw shot-by-shot contamination trace gap.

candidates.title: Troubleshooting Black Specks and Color Streaks in Injection Molded Parts
data: measured melt/barrel temperature and plasticising response
scrap/streak response before and after diagnostic interventions
candidates.rightsState: publisher-controlled article; use as evidence/reference and create original Book explanations rather than reproducing protected figures/tables
candidates.value: Direct black-speck/color-streak case evidence showing how process perturbation, natural-resin trials and screw/NRV inspection can discriminate degraded-resin, stagnant-region and masterbatch hypotheses.
candidates.limitations: Case-series evidence from specific machines/materials; tested temperatures, back pressures and screw speeds are not transferable production settings.

candidates.title: Detection of Inclusions and Degradation in Injection-Molded Thermoplastics
data: actual PET injection-blow preforms containing inclusions
PET degraded intentionally by residence-time control
candidates.rightsState: peer-reviewed publisher article; reuse licence not established from the institutional record, so keep reference-only until rights are rechecked
candidates.value: Provides a defensible analytical ladder for distinguishing foreign inclusions from polymer degradation instead of diagnosing dark particles by appearance alone.
candidates.limitations: PET/preform study and laboratory-analysis protocol; it does not identify every contaminant or replace process-history evidence.

candidates.title: Implementasi Metode DMAIC untuk Perbaikan Defect Produksi Preform pada Perusahaan Manufaktur Injection Plastic
candidates.scale: 29,399 reported defective 14.20 g preforms in the study population; 11,200 black-speck/contamination defects
data: post-improvement black-speck share reported to decrease from 38% to 32%
candidates.rightsState: repository abstract is public; thesis chapters are access-restricted, so only public abstract-level findings may be used unless access/reuse permission is obtained
candidates.value: Adds quantified plant-level defect prevalence plus a maintenance intervention/follow-up outcome, which is closer to the Book's desired fault-action-recovery pattern than generic troubleshooting lists.
candidates.limitations: Non-peer-reviewed undergraduate thesis; available public evidence is abstract-level and the reported percentage change is not a raw shot-linked time series.

candidates.title: Using Data to Pinpoint Cosmetic Defect Causes in Injection Molded Parts
data: black particle embedded in moulded polycarbonate part
candidates.rightsState: commercial laboratory case article; reference-only and do not reproduce proprietary images without permission
candidates.value: Useful practical example of escalating from visual evidence to elemental and molecular analysis when a black inclusion cannot be identified from appearance or process settings alone.
candidates.limitations: Commercial practitioner case, not a controlled moulding experiment; analytical identification does not by itself prove when or where contamination entered the process.

candidates.title: The Hot Runner Valve Pin as Actuating Variable — Cavity-Specific Pressure Control to Increase Process Consistency
data: measured pressure changes due to pin movement
candidates.rightsState: technical publisher article; reference-only unless republication rights are verified
candidates.value: Adds direct measured evidence that hot-runner pin position can alter local pressure transfer during the holding phase and can serve as a controlled actuator rather than assuming commanded state equals cavity response.
candidates.limitations: One experimental hot-runner system; measured pressure changes and pin strokes are not generic control limits.

candidates.title: KaskaRe — Hot runner pressure control
candidates.rightsState: public institutional project page; figures/data remain source-controlled unless reuse terms explicitly permit
candidates.value: Current continuation of the hot-runner pin-control evidence family and a useful example of using actual actuator stroke and cavity pressure instead of treating valve command as proof of delivered cavity state.
candidates.limitations: Same broader IKV control family as the 2021 article; it must not be counted as an independent experiment without experiment-level separation.
